newsitem.title: UK: Tempest survey of best funds, brokers for Asia.
newsitem.headline: Tempest survey of best funds, brokers for Asia.

text.p: The following are the key rankings for the Asia region from a Reuters-sponsored survey of 27 emerging markets operators conducted by Tempest Consultants over the past three months.
The report compiled responses from over 840 fund managers and buy-side analysts, over 230 national and international brokers and some 1,700 brokers' analysts.
The fund manager ranking for the best broker research product and service for Asia:
Funds' ratings of brokers with best execution ability:
Funds' ratings of broker communication skills:
Best written research: 1.ING Barings 2.Credit Lyonnais 3.W I Carr
Best analyst telephone calls: 1.Credit Lyonnais 2.W I Carr 3.ING Barings
Best analyst visits: 1.Credit Lyonnais 2.ING Barings 3. W I Carr
Best sales Skills: 1. BZW 2.ING Barings 3.W I Carr
Fund manager perception of broker research priorities:
Joint 1st : W I Carr, BZW and HG Asia

In Asia, fund managers said they met an average of 172 companies last year. Their preference for level of meeting on these visits were CEO's or finance directors, then investor relations officer and public relations officer.
Some 69.26 percent intended to increase their direct contact with companies next year, while 30.74 percent said there would be no change and none intended to visit less.
The ranking by finance directors of the top 10 individual fund managers for the Asia region:
Joint 6th place : Yosawadee Charnsethikul of Fidelity Investments, the team at LGT Asset Management and David Ma at Merrill Lynch Asset Management
9. Team at J.P. Morgan Investment Management.
The ranking by finance directors of the top 10 fund management groups for Asia:
Joint 6th place : Merrill Lynch Asset Management, Jardine Fleming Investment Management
The rankings by finance directors of best broker research in Asia:
Best written Research: 1. Merrill Lynch 2. SBC Warburg Securities 3. Jardine Fleming
Best use of Time: 1. Jardine Fleming 2. Merrill Lynch 3. SBC Warburg Securities
Depth of knowledge: 1. Merrill Lynch 2. Jardine Fleming 3. SBC Warburg Securities
Quality of relationship: 1. Merrill Lynch 2. Jardine Fleming 3. SBC Warburg Securities
The full report, including an explanation of methodology, is available from Tempest Consultants in London.
